verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents that you can leave its Cloud service for self-hosting the open-source server without rewriting application code. Its Egress feature exports room media in open formats (MP4, HLS). However, nothing in the evidence describes exporting all account or project data (configurations, agent definitions, logs, metrics, phone numbers) from LiveKit Cloud in a bulk export. Missing for 10: a documented full account/project data export, open-format export of non-media data (agent configs, logs, metrics), and independent corroboration of a Cloud-to-self-hosted migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can move from LiveKit Cloud to self-hosted if your requirements change.
You can start on open source and migrate to LiveKit Cloud without rewriting application code.
It supports recording to an MP4 file or HLS segments
To export a single video track without transcoding, set the `PASSTHROUGH` encoding preset, which writes the track in its native container.
